اقتصرتما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَرْتُمَا (iqtaṣartumā) /iq.ta.sˤar.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اُقْتُصِرْتُمَا (uqtuṣirtumā) /uq.tu.sˤir.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
